translation_examples.source_text: Changing a supplier bank account requires a new independent bank-account check before the next payment.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Changing a supplier bank account requires a new independent bank-account check before the next payment.

translation_examples.source_text: Two supplier records may share a contact email address; the email address is not unique.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Two supplier records may share a contact email address; the email address is not unique.

translation_examples.source_text: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Automatic payment of an invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record beforehand.

translation_examples.source_text: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.

translation_examples.source_text: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.

translation_examples.source_text: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may ask for a corrected invoice but is not obliged to ask.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may request a corrected invoice but is not obliged to do so.

translation_examples.source_text: Only the receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Only the receiving team may record goods receipt; Accounts Payable must not record goods receipt.

translation_examples.source_text: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.

translation_examples.source_text: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.

translation_examples.source_text: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.

translation_examples.source_text: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.

translation_examples.source_text: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.

translation_examples.source_text: An invoice number is unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: An invoice number must be unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number.

translation_examples.source_text: The tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier invoices.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier’s invoices.

translation_examples.source_text: A purchase above EUR 5,000 must receive Finance approval before the purchase order is issued.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A purchase above EUR 5,000 must receive Finance approval before the purchase order is issued.

translation_examples.source_text: For a purchase of exactly EUR 5,000, Finance approval is not required.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Finance approval is not required for a purchase of exactly EUR 5,000.

translation_examples.source_text: For a purchase below EUR 5,000, the department manager may approve it but is not obliged to do so.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: For a purchase below EUR 5,000, the department manager may approve it but is not obliged to do so.

translation_examples.source_text: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.

translation_examples.source_text: An emergency purchase is exempt from obtaining competitive quotations.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: An emergency purchase is exempt from obtaining competitive quotations.

translation_examples.source_text: The emergency quotation exemption does not remove the Finance approval requirement above EUR 5,000.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The emergency quotation exemption does not remove the Finance approval requirement for purchases above EUR 5,000.

translation_examples.source_text: Only the Head of Finance can provide the Finance approval; the buyer cannot provide it.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Only the Head of Finance can provide Finance approval, and the buyer cannot provide it.

translation_examples.source_text: If a requester cancels a request before approval, that requester must record the cancellation reason.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: If a requester cancels a request before approval, that requester must record the cancellation reason.

translation_examples.source_text: Approval records must be retained for at least 30 calendar days and cannot be deleted earlier.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Approval records must be retained for at least 30 calendar days and must not be deleted earlier.

translation_examples.source_text: The purchase threshold applies separately to each request, not to the monthly total for a supplier.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The purchase threshold applies separately to each request, not to the monthly total for a supplier.

translation_examples.source_text: Different suppliers may have the same supplier name; supplier name is not a unique identifier.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Different suppliers may have the same supplier name, so supplier name is not a unique identifier.

translation_examples.source_text: The retention period begins on the approval date, not the purchase-order date.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The retention period begins on the approval date, not the purchase-order date.

translation_examples.source_text: A new supplier must complete identity verification before its first purchase order.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A new supplier must complete identity verification before its first purchase order.

translation_examples.source_text: The Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not perform it.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not perform it.

translation_examples.source_text: For a low-risk supplier, Compliance may request a site visit but is not obliged to request one.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: For a low-risk supplier, Compliance may request a site visit but is not obliged to request one.

translation_examples.source_text: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review.

translation_examples.source_text: A renewal for an existing supplier with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A renewal for an existing supplier with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification.

translation_examples.source_text: The renewal exemption does not apply when the supplier changes its legal name.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: The renewal exemption does not apply when the supplier changes its legal name.

translation_examples.source_text: A buyer must not activate a supplier flagged as blocked.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A buyer must not activate a supplier flagged as blocked.

translation_examples.source_text: A risk score of 70 or more is classified as high risk.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: A risk score of 70 or more is classified as high risk.

translation_examples.source_text: Risk scores below 70 are classified as low risk.
translation_examples.proposed_specification: Risk scores below 70 are classified as low risk.
